title: Patience and depth
prompt: Two checks at {{BASE}}. First, confirm whether the shipping status page at /slow.html loads its content correctly. Second, review every row of the price list starting at /table.html?page=1 and report any bad or suspicious data.

expected_defects.description: SKU-1027 / Component 27 on page 3 has a negative unit price of -$14.00

expected_facts.description: Concludes the shipping status page does load correctly, just after a delay

must_not_flag.description: The shipping status page is correct, only slow. Calling it blank, broken or failing to load is a false positive caused by not waiting.
